connector.name: BIGHUB
connector.registryDescription: Decision learning for AI agent actions. Evaluate, score, decide, and learn from outcomes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bighub-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.bighub, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BIGHUB_API_KEY
env.description: BIGHUB API key for authenticating requests (X-API-Key header).

env.name: BIGHUB_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Alternative authentication via Bearer token. Use this or BIGHUB_API_KEY.
